name: train-data-d1
description: D1 of status/preregistrations/train-psm-lfm-v1.json (teacher: tier small): the teacher writes, for one book problem, the PSM structure (verbatim labelled spans, relations) and the per-sentence FOL with the agreed extension (Value, Ask, comparisons, Before/After, ? queries). checks.mjs accepts only replies our deterministic converters compile; execution against the book answer and the two-teacher perturbation agreement run afterwards (tools/eval/structure-formalizer/d1.mjs). Training data stays local (DS011).
